set.body:
Objective
Frame-erased values that still tie their value's type to their own frame, with checked binding to static spaces.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (D1 binding). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
image; scalafim.image.space. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Placed[V[_ <: Frame[D3]]] with val frame and value: V[frame.type]; only constructor takes V[f.type].
2. Rebind[V] instances for points, GridSpec and pull maps via FrameAlignment; bindTo fails on mismatched keys.
3. Spaces.* stable vals for MNI152NLin2009cAsym, MNI152NLin6Asym, MNI305, fsaverage, fsLR.
4. compileErrors tests: Placed(mniFrame)(subjectPoint) rejected; p.value unusable as Point[Mni2009c] without bindTo; cross-frame andThen rejected.

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Negative-compile tests run in shared code on both platforms.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P1.03: Placed dependent pair, Rebind, and static Spaces singletons
